---
title: "Module 9 --- Flight controller, PCB and dry testing"
---

## Summary

The core robot assembled and validated, the flight controller flashed and talking to the ESC, and the robot flapping in air under wireless control.

## Requirements

|           |                                   |
|-----------|-----------------------------------|
| **Parts** | Robot                             |
| **Tools** | Power source, USB-C cable, Laptop |
| **Read**  | This page                         |

## What you should have by now

1.  Core of the robot, including the reduction mounted to the motor vertical plate and to the gear vertical plate.

2.  A first set of wings

3.  A tail or tail tube

4.  Trailing edge attachment point at the end of the fuselage (wing-dependent)

## Dry testing

::: callout-note
## Checkpoint

Flight controller commanding the ESC over serial, and a supervised flapping run in air.
:::
